paper_title: Upper limit on the axion-photon coupling from magnetic white dwarf polarization
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 1
notes: Fiducial (conservative) 95% CL upper limit |g_agamma| < 5.4e-12 GeV^-1 from non-observation of axion-induced linear polarization of MWD SDSS J135141, valid for m_a <~ 3e-7 eV (encoded as a flat bound spanning the Fig. 1 mass range lower edge ~1e-11 eV up to 3e-7 eV; above this the sensitivity degrades quadratically with m_a, but no digitized data is available for that region). This is a purely astrophysical bound (no DM assumption). Paper also reports weaker/comparable limits from Grw+70 8247 (~0.73% Lp) and PG 1031+234 (8.8e-12 GeV^-1), but the headline result is the SDSS J135141 fiducial limit. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 38)) | Vision: Exclusion plot is Fig. 1 on page 1 (fig_00.png).
